label: D2 after choosing a1, following an unrewarded trial or a switch to a1
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when this trial's choice was a1 (in_action == 1). It never fires at D1 or GO, and never after an a2 choice. Within D2 after a1 it fires on about 16% of steps. The rate goes up when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0 holds 83% of the mass) and when the a1 choice was a switch from a2 (stay == 0: 70% precision, and the largest activations). Rare transitions to S2 also increase the rate. The top activations are a1 -> S2 rare after an unrewarded trial, usually switches to a1. The rate also rises later in the episode (trial 50-89) and is low in the first ~30 trials. Recorded predicate (dev: P 0.36, R 0.84, F1 0.51, mass recall 0.91) uses only variables observed at D2. Precision is limited because many a1/D2 steps after a non-reward stay silent, and adding ep_trial >= 40 only raises F1 to 0.54. Magnitude is largest for switches to a1 and for rare a1 -> S2 transitions.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_action=1 (+3.81), phase=D2 & this=a1 S2 (+1.98), stay=0 (+1.43), next_stay=0 (+1.37), prev_state=2 (+1.34), last=a1 S1 u (+1.13). Lower it: action=2 (-3.98), in_action=2 (-3.75), in_state=0 (-3.54), in_action=0 (-3.38).
